title.text: SOUL · landing v3, ready for the Shopify store

heroNote.text: Hero on the live site: the stone stays pinned while you scroll. It wakes, the S·U·L letters slide apart and fade, the stone grows to centre and "palm-sized. aluminium. alive." appears. This board shows the first frame.

stickyNote.text: Mobile: the bottom bar (from €249 · join the waitlist) is pinned to the viewport on the live site; drawn here at the first fold.

pdpNote.text: Product page: pre-launch, so the buy box ends in the waitlist, never a cart. Colour swatches, views, the waitlist form, "birth yours" and chip lookup are live (same birth math as the device).
